name: WeChat
description: Chat with your Bot from WeChat. Messages you send to the WeChat ClawBot reach your Bot, and its replies come back to the same chat.

setup.title: Connect WeChat
setup.description: Link your WeChat account by scanning a QR code. Your WeChat account needs the ClawBot entry, which WeChat is rolling out in stages.
steps: Choose Connect to display a QR code.
Scan the code with WeChat and confirm on your phone.
In WeChat, send your ClawBot a first message so your Bot can reply.

deviceLink.instructions: Scan this code with WeChat and confirm on your phone. Your account needs the WeChat ClawBot entry.

skills.name: wechat
skills.description: Reply to the account owner in WeChat from a conversation that came from WeChat, check the WeChat connection, and see who has written. Use when a message arrived through WeChat or the user asks about the WeChat connection.
